_comment: Hand-kept list of the Base Body pages the pipeline cuts (KTD3). Each entry: "id" is a stable string the app and the web version key on, never a sequence number; "pdf" is the scan's basename, found anywhere under content/source; "page" is 0-indexed; "group" is one of the pipeline's GROUPS; "region" is which doll on the page counting from the left (0-indexed), or null when the page holds one doll. A page with two dolls of similar height is refused until "region" says which one. Populated after the parent has looked at the triage contact sheets.
